premise.claim: The RBG discovery ConfigMap stores a full enumeration of every instance address; ~43 bytes/pod claimed, a 4000-replica role with 5 pods per instance crosses the 1 MiB ConfigMap limit, and every scale event rewrites the whole object to every mounting node.
premise.evidence: Enumeration is O(pods); measured ~129 bytes/entry for the KEP's example shape (CCP leader1+worker4, ports http+grpc) => 4000x5 entries ~ 2.6 MB > 1 MiB. results/unit-l1-head.txt. (Note: the Summary's own '~43 bytes/pod crosses the limit' arithmetic is wrong — 860 KB — see F4.)
